reason: I'd love something that follows up leads while I sleep, but "CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365..." doesn't tell me it works with the booking tool and inbox I actually use. I'd poke at the free plan first, and 99 € a month isn't something I pay before I've seen it save me real hours.
objection: It probably doesn't plug into my specific tools, so I'd end up copying things across by hand at night anyway, and I can't tell what 100 credits actually gets me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it connected to my own tools during the free demo and following up a real lead for me on its own within the first week.
